scope: credited outcome of a non-fouled missed field goal (12 classes), conditional on the miss; 703 eligible of 742 episodes
test_command: Rscript src/rebounding/run_tests.R unit orientation; Rscript src/rebounding/run_tests.R gates step_01

deviations.check: orientation: ball at shots.endFrame within 6 ft of the attacked hoop, >= 98% per direction (prespecified)
deviations.result: attacks camera-right hoop (flip +1) 96.3%; attacks camera-left hoop (flip -1) 94.5%
deviations.decision: Superseded after the first run: every outlier is a blocked shot, an airball or heave, or a shot whose endFrame comes before the ball reaches the rim, so the check measured endFrame semantics, not orientation. Replaced by an endFrame-free check (ball nearer the attacked hoop than the other, same 98% share). Owner to confirm.

deviations.check: joins: event gameClock equals tracking gameClock
deviations.decision: Tolerance 0.001 s set after the first run; the first run used 1e-6 s, fixed in code without a stated reason.

reviewer: Claude (automated run; tracking-plot review from Gate 0); owner review pending
open_risks: Contact, touch and control frames are automated proxies (Step 02 reviews them)
5 of 64 reviewed player rebounds credit a player who never reaches the ball in tracking (identity_suspect flags 33 eligible)
Single reviewer, tracking plots only; no video ships with the data and outside video is not allowed
decision_note: All Step 01 audits documented and passed.
